styleLock.direction: premium diffuse-lighting detail-page commerce, cool plaster-studio system with physically correct light pools
styleLock.backgroundSystem: two-field system held across the whole set: the fitting lives on cool light-grey studio plaster fields #EDEEF0 with matte plinth blocks #DDE0E4 and a white marble-veined sheet #F4F5F6, never a warm room tint; copy bands, spec cards and label rows sit on a muted lilac-grey band #C3C0D9 or on matte white cards #FFFFFF edged with hairline #C9CDD2; the near-black textured wall field #23262A is reserved only for screens where the luminaire is switched on; installed scenes use flat matte gypsum ceiling planes #F7F8F9
styleLock.lightingSystem: bright soft neutral-cool 6500K key from the upper left with a large white bounce on the shadow side, gentle gradient falloff, soft contact shadow grounding the fitting, one continuous specular run along each die-cast fin and one crisp highlight line along the chamfered bevel; whenever the product is switched on the light must land as a physically plausible pool on a wall or floor with a defined edge and orderly falloff, the fitting body itself staying dim and readable, never a glowing disc, halo, bloom or star flare
styleLock.surfaceSystem: matte painted plaster plinths #DDE0E4 and a white marble-veined sheet #F4F5F6 on studio fields, matte gypsum ceiling #F7F8F9 and pale stone floor #DFDCD7 in installed scenes; no wood grain macro, no fabric macro, no warm concrete
styleLock.typography: one modern geometric sans-serif family for all Chinese and Latin characters; every rendered string is a short placeholder wrapped in 「」, headline 26-44pt, subline 16-22pt, label 12-16pt; titles in #2F343A on light fields and #FFFFFF on dark fields, body labels in #4A5057; no dense body copy and no keyboard-gibberish filler strings
styleLock.iconSystem: thin single-weight 2px line glyphs only, #3F9C8E on light fields and #FFFFFF on dark fields; recurring frame furniture: rounded pill labels joined to the part by a hairline dot-leader, circular proof chips on white cards, two thin curved airflow glyphs used only as diagram, hairline #C9CDD2 dividers and dashed bracket tick rules carrying no numerals
styleLock.presentationRules: identical trim-ring proportion, identical deep anti-glare recess, identical bevel width and identical fin rhythm in every shot; on studio fields the fitting is tilted 20-30 degrees off vertical so the recessed optic and the finned back read together; the two symmetric spring clips stay opposite each other and the external driver stays a separate rectangular block; the diffuser always renders as a matte opal lens #F2F3F1, never as an emitter; no hands, no faces, no installed-in-dust condition
noDrift: no glowing blob or halo instead of a real light pool
no added logo, watermark or QR code
no invented wattage, lumen, CRI, beam angle, colour temperature, cut-out size, IP rating, warranty term or certification

provenance.notes: 源为一张详情页长图的 10 个切片，逐片判读主体为嵌入式 LED 筒灯：一体化压铸铝灯身带径向散热鳍片，深防眩内收的乳白扩散面，亮银斜边面环，两侧对称钢质弹簧卡扣，另配独立外置矩形驱动电源；面环有两种工艺（烤漆亮白 / 磨砂砂银），出光有两种色调，源片 01/04/05/09 分别给出棚场首屏、家居洗墙、商业走廊阵列与光色对比。分类：taxonomy 无照明大类，灯具归 L1「家装灯具」，L2 逐字符取「灯饰」（灯具本体，非「电工」「五金」「建材」）。已合并近似重复版式：切片 02/03 同为单品加胶囊标注、切片 05/06 同为工装场景加暗底标题，各归一镜；切片 01/02 的两排圆形图标合并为首屏三枚凭证胶囊，最终按转化漏斗重排为 11 镜。已剥离：全部原品牌与店铺信息（源表中的「某品牌」「科锐芯片」等一律不带入，并在 Negative 中禁造商标）、「加入会员 全店免费」角标与二维码（改为通用按钮占位）、切片 06/07 中「ICO」标题下的键盘乱序填充正文（改为 placeholder 文案）、商场场景内可见的第三方店铺招牌（明令禁止可识别店面）、家庭场景中可辨识人脸（改为不入镜）。所有参数一律不带入具体数值：开孔与直径范围、瓦数档位、色温数值、质保年限、退换天数与认证名号（3C 等）全部改为 {callout_*} 引线占位，并在每镜 Negative 中禁造瓦数、流明、显色、光束角、色温、开孔、IP、质保与认证。灯具专项：要求保留投影轮廓、散热鳍片、驱动与卡扣几何、面环与阳极/烤漆工艺；点亮时只允许呈现带清晰边缘、按距离规律衰减的物理光池，明令禁止发光团、光晕、星芒与裸露灯珠。机位含正面 3/4、正 90 度侧视、后侧 45 度、正 90 度俯视、高角度微距、极低角度仰视与两枚微距，全景占比约三分之一。库内去重：家装灯具已有 24 个模版且无「灯饰」条目，本模版以灯具本体光效与冷灰石膏棚场加强调色体系立项，与同库「不锈钢旋钮锁紧管夹支架」的深蓝近黑镜面金属体系及各类五金电工模版主题、色板与版式均不重叠。
